headline: SEO & Content Growth | Digital Strategy | Analytics Leadership
headline_rationale: Graphite Director requires SEO/content growth strategy, complex project ownership and executive insights; allows digital marketing background with SEO interest. Use supported SEO consulting, web development, analytics and team leadership without claiming AEO/programmatic specialties.
summary: Digital growth leader bringing search visibility, content and conversion analysis into a connected strategy. Consulted on SEO and on-page optimization, developed personalized content across web and email, and worked with web teams on performance priorities. Built reporting across more than ten marketing channels, used predictive and regression models to guide investment decisions, and led an eight-person e-commerce team. Technical website work and agency consulting add practical execution depth for translating complex data and project requirements into clear growth recommendations.
factual_review: Read exact Graphite SEO/AEO Growth Director description. Supports US via distributed North America and worldwide language. E044/E114/E106/E009/E005/E010/E093/E001/E076 support claims. No AEO results, six-year programmatic SEO claim or unsupported Ahrefs expertise; distinct summary from2990.
tools_rationale: Supported search, reporting, analysis and AI tools appropriate to Graphite growth leadership without unverified specialist platforms.
